name: Cayous

attributes.attribute: the Arthurian figure whose name appears as Cayous

text: Cayous is a variant spelling of Sir Kay. Writers of Arthurian romance use this form for the same figure. Kay stands among the foremost knights of Arthur's court. The forms differ, yet the hero behind them stays one man.

okr.objective: Cayous records a spelling of the knight Kay.
key_results: The form Cayous names the Arthurian figure Sir Kay.
It marks one spelling of a single hero.
okr.evidence: MacKillop, Dictionary of Celtic Mythology, s.v. 'Cayous'
